full_text:
Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in these Rules are defined as follows:
1. "Digitized document" means a housing lease contract converted from a paper document or other non-electronic document into a form processable by an information system.
2. "Electronic fixed date" means a fixed date assigned to a digitized document through the Supreme Court Internet Registry Office (hereinafter referred to as the "Internet Registry Office") pursuant to Article 3-6 of the Housing Lease Protection Act.
